component.name: Glowcast
component.summary: Sync your Hue lights with your screen, games and music

description.p: Glowcast syncs your Philips Hue lights with your screen, your games and your music, or sets a scene, through your Hue entertainment area. It follows the official Hue Sync app for Windows and macOS, in a native GNOME app for Wayland.

ul.li: Video and Games: lights follow your screen, across several monitors
Music: lights follow your desktop audio, with colour palettes of your own
Scenes: Hue Sync's scene gallery, your own scenes and your bridge's scenes
Switch modes while syncing, and control Glowcast with keyboard shortcuts
Capture area, background lighting, sync delay and vocal filter

description.p: Screen capture goes through the desktop's screen-share dialog, and nothing you watch or hear leaves your computer. Requires a Philips Hue Bridge with an entertainment area set up in the Hue app.
Glowcast is based on Lumux by Engin Kırmacı. It is not affiliated with Signify or Philips Hue.

screenshot.caption: Music: lights follow your desktop audio
Scenes: a gallery, your own scenes and your bridge's scenes
Video: lights follow your screen, with a live preview

description.p: First version of Glowcast, based on Lumux by Engin Kırmacı.

ul.li: Scenes, Games, Music and Video, switchable while syncing
Several monitors at once, with a capture area you drag on the live preview
Music palettes and scenes of your own, plus the scenes on your bridge
The window glows with your lights
Keyboard shortcuts, sync delay, background lighting and a vocal filter
